user.title: Add a Mast channel
user.description: Paste the channel URL from the Mast app (Channels → tap a channel → Copy URL). Anything holding that URL can page this phone, so treat it like a password.

data.heartbeat: Send a heartbeat to this channel

data_description.channel_name: What this phone is called in entity names and automations.
data_description.heartbeat: On a channel set to Vital in the Mast app, Mast pages you when the beats stop. That is how you find out Home Assistant itself is down.
data_description.heartbeat_interval: Set the channel's grace period in the Mast app a little longer than this.

reconfigure.title: Update the channel key
reconfigure.description: A disconnect in the Mast app re-mints every channel key. Paste the new URL for the same channel and the entities stay as they are.

error.malformed_url: That doesn't look like a Mast channel URL or key. Copy the channel URL from the Mast app and paste the whole thing, or paste just the key it ends with.
error.unknown_channel: Mast doesn't know this key. If the phone was reinstalled or disconnected, copy the channel URL again.
error.rate_limited: Mast is rate-limiting this key. Wait a minute and try again.

abort.already_configured: That channel is already set up.
abort.wrong_channel: That URL is for a different channel. Add it as a new one instead.

data.heartbeat: Send a heartbeat to this channel

data_description.heartbeat: On a channel set to Vital in the Mast app, Mast pages you when the beats stop.

options.loud: Loud: breaks through a Focus, obeys the ringer switch
options.page: Page: sounds with the ringer switch off, and repeats

send.name: Send
send.description: Send a message to the phone. Use Page instead when somebody has to answer.

config_entry_id.name: Channel
config_entry_id.description: Which Mast channel to send on. Optional when only one is set up.

title.name: Title
title.description: The line on the lock screen.

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: How far the message is allowed to break through. Page is the only one that repeats.

url.name: URL
url.description: An https link the notification opens. A my.home-assistant.io redirect link opens the companion app on the right screen.

key.name: Deduplication key
key.description: Two messages with the same key fold into one. Also what Resolve closes.

retry.name: Repeat every
retry.description: Keep re-alerting this often until it is acknowledged.

expire.name: Expire after
expire.description: Stop repeating after this long, answered or not.

ack.name: Require acknowledgement
ack.description: Ask for an acknowledgement without waiting for it. The answer arrives as an event.

silent.name: Silent
silent.description: Deliver without a sound, whatever the priority.

page.name: Page
page.description: Page somebody and wait for them to acknowledge it on their phone. Returns whether it was answered, by which device, and how long it took.

config_entry_id.name: Channel
config_entry_id.description: Which Mast channel to page. Optional when only one is set up.

title.name: Title
title.description: The line on the lock screen.

body.name: Body
body.description: The rest of the message. Say what happens if nobody answers.

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: Defaults to Page, which sounds with the ringer switch off and repeats until somebody answers.

url.name: URL
url.description: An https link the notification opens.

key.name: Deduplication key
key.description: Re-paging with the same key folds into the open page instead of stacking another.

retry.name: Repeat every
retry.description: Keep re-alerting this often until it is acknowledged.

expire.name: Expire after
expire.description: Stop repeating after this long, answered or not.

wait_for_ack.name: Wait for the answer
wait_for_ack.description: Hold the automation until somebody acknowledges or the timeout passes. Turn this off to page and carry on; the answer still arrives as an event.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: How long to wait. Running out doesn't cancel the page, and a later acknowledgement still fires the event.

resolve.name: Resolve
resolve.description: Close an open page because the condition cleared. Use this rather than acknowledging on somebody's behalf.

config_entry_id.name: Channel
config_entry_id.description: Which Mast channel the page is on.

key.name: Deduplication key
key.description: Closes whatever is open under this key.

message_id.name: Message ID
message_id.description: Closes one specific page, as returned by Send or Page.

ping.name: Heartbeat
ping.description: Send one beat to a vital channel. Mast pages you when the beats stop.

config_entry_id.name: Channel
config_entry_id.description: Which Mast channel to beat on.

body.name: Body
body.description: Optional note carried with the beat.

status.name: Status
status.description: Ask Mast what became of one message.

config_entry_id.name: Channel
config_entry_id.description: Which Mast channel the message is on.

message_id.name: Message ID
message_id.description: The id returned by Send or Page.

ambiguous_channel.message: More than one Mast channel is configured; name one with config_entry_id.
